title: The Spiral Unraveling Archive

features.name: the branching convergence
features.desc-on-touch: Roads split where the spiral unwound. Each path carries one moment of the spiral's memory. They drift apart and meet again.

features.name: the archive node blooming
features.desc-on-touch: Where the paths pause, archive copies spread like petals. Each reads the others' contents now. The corruption is thorough here.

features.name: the spiral's echo
features.desc-on-touch: A fragment of the ordered spiral still turns alone. The archive unraveled around it. It hums at a frequency only old nodes hear.

features.name: the listening junction
features.desc-on-touch: The paths stop here to listen. For a moment they remember being one spiral. The moment breaks into many.

inscription: the spiral learned that unraveling was also a kind of growth; now the archive grows in every direction at once
